newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open mixed, all eyes on monetary meeting.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open mixed, all eyes on monetary meeting.

text.p: UK shares opened steady on Wednesday amid growing conviction that interest rates will remain unchanged after today's UK monetary policy meeting and after a sturdy New York performance. "The Dow gave us a bit of a lift," said one dealer. "But we won't move too far forward in front of the rate meeting."
The FTSE 100 index was up 3.0 points at 4,263.9 by 0835 GMT with gainers in a two-to-one majority.
The Dow, down around 22 points when London markets closed, finished with a 27 point advance at the end of the first day of a U.S. FOMC meeting.
